vector_memory.semantic_summary: This module manages the planning phase for shadow mapping, determining which lights cast shadows and how to allocate their depth views within a fixed-size shadow atlas. It calculates necessary light matrices (orthographic/perspective) and defines the geometric layout via ShadowPlan structures. The core logic involves filtering lights by budget and distance, then serializing the resulting plan into a GPU-consumable Float32Array conforming to the ShadowsBlock UBO layout.
